About.title: I’m a <hl>developer</hl> who loves the details
About.p1: Mamdouh Helmy, a full-stack developer from Egypt. I learned to code and built complete platforms and websites by hand, from the database to the last button on the screen. The latest one was the website for Raqmyat, a Saudi company.
About.p2: I worked as a full-stack developer at Code School, and I built a full learning platform on my own. I care about sites that are fast, easy to use, and handle Arabic and English properly, and about code that stays clean and easy to extend later.
